anchor.title: The Gateway Arch is completed
anchor.description: After more than two years of building its two legs separately, crews set the 10-ton final section at the top of the 630-foot Arch. The morning sun had expanded the south leg so much that workers sprayed it with fire hoses to cool it, then used a hydraulic jack to pry the legs apart so the last piece could slide in. Vice President Hubert Humphrey watched from a helicopter.

image.alt: The final section of the Gateway Arch being lifted into place at the top, October 28, 1965

wright.hint: They picked the spot for its steady wind and soft sand dunes on a barrier island.

mcd.clue: A milkshake-mixer salesman opens the first burger stand he franchised himself.
mcd.hint: A suburb next to what became one of the world's busiest airports.

titanic.clue: A brand-new liner called unsinkable strikes an iceberg on its first voyage.
